scope: agent-supplied geometry to independent source BIM; no correction run or solver stage

source_geometry_self_consistency.scope: source geometry, contacts and explicit opening hosts

agent_assumptions: Interior corridor/office door heights (D1-D6) assumed 2.1m to match the two elevation-evidenced entrance doors (D7,D8); not separately shown in any elevation.

West wall vestibule/porch recess (~1m deep, corridor width) simplified to a flush exterior wall with a single wide entrance door D7 spanning the corridor width; the small projecting porch geometry itself is not modeled.
South wall small notch/chamfer near the SW entrance simplified to a flush wall with a single door D8.
All door swing/open states left unknown.
Plan spaces were compiled deterministically from the declared footprint and physical partition segments; no snapping, extension, clipping, or inferred partition was applied.
unresolved: Vestibule/porch recess geometry on the west facade and the SW corner wall notch are simplified/not modeled as separate enclosed space; only door openings are represented.
Small furniture items (desks, chairs, L-shaped workstation) not modeled; only partitions/openings captured.
Pixel-to-world calibration was supplied by the caller and was not independently verified.

source_validation.scope: source geometry, contacts and explicit opening hosts

input_view_status.note: Only this run's hash-bound view_image returns are counted. Other image tools, workers and prior runs are outside this scope. A returned image is not proof of examination, complete coverage, correct interpretation or applied heights. Use supplied relevant elevations to check each floor's opening heights; do not transfer a typical height to an unexamined opening family.

plan_compilation.basis: 1F: outer wall faces measured to dimension ticks for 15000x8000 overall (matches labeled 15000 and 8000mm chains). Interior partitions at x=5.0m and x=10.0m (piers, from double-line wall support scan) run full building depth. Corridor bounded by two full-width walls at y=5.0m and y=3.0m (from 3000/250/1500/250/3000 mm dimension chain), each with 3 door openings measured from wall-line gaps (pixel profile of wall colour at y=618-629 and y=804-815). West wall has a recessed vestibule/porch (approx 1m deep) at the corridor width; simplified here to a flush wall with one double-width entrance door at x=0 spanning the corridor width (y=3.25-4.75), matching the West elevation door (height evidenced 0-2.1m). South wall of the SW office has a small wall notch/chamfer (~0.3m) around its entrance; simplified to a flush wall with a single door (matches 540/900mm bottom dimension and South elevation door 0-2.1m). Windows measured from cyan hatch band extents on each facade; north/south office windows read from 2400mm-module dimension chain, corridor windows on east/west from 1200mm dimension chain.

source_plan_views.scope: actual saved source plan; no original calibration, height verification or drawing-fidelity verdict

space_ink_review.interpretation: Long horizontal/vertical neutral ink inside the submitted space, not detected walls. Inspect the complete clean room and both sides of each line. It may be a partition, furniture, text or other drawing mark. No strokes is not proof of an open or correctly partitioned space.
limits: Only axis-aligned, high-support neutral lines at the reported filter settings are sampled; oblique, short, interrupted or low-contrast lines may be missed.
Inset boundary bands are excluded. Results depend on the submitted room polygon; unbuilt rooms outside it are not searched.
No wall classification, room count, automatic repair or acceptance verdict.
space_ink_review.follow_up: Use view_image with the original image name and a flagged room's original_box for additional clean context. Recheck whether the original has one physical space or separate rooms; revise the saved plan only when supported. Preserve real apertures and other rooms. Zero strokes is not a fidelity pass.

space_ink_views.mapping: Multiply returned coordinates by native_pixels_per_returned_pixel, subtract the chosen panel origin, then add crop_original_pixels origin. Stroke numeric coordinates already use original pixels.
